children: ") an energy transition resource exploration and technology company, announces that, further to its news release dated September 22, 2026, the Company has closed the first tranche (the "
") of its previously announced non-brokered private placement (the "
"), through the issuance of 101,000 units of the Company (each, a "
") at a price of $2.40 per Unit, for aggregate gross proceeds of $242,400 Each Unit consists of one common share in the capital of the Company (each, a "
") and one transferable common share purchase warrant (each, a "
"). Each Warrant entitles the holder to acquire one additional Share (each, a "
") at an exercise price of $2.50 per Warrant Share, exercisable until October 6, 2028.

The net proceeds of the Private Placement are intended to be allocated toward corporate awareness initiatives. The securities issued under the Private Placement will be subject to a statutory hold period expiring February 7, 2027.

The remaining portion of the Private Placement is expected to close, in whole or in part, in one or more additional tranches on or before November 6, 2026, subject to compliance with the policies of the Canadian Securities Exchange.
In connection with the closing of the First Tranche, the Company paid aggregate cash finder's fees of $2,160 to registered dealers.

This press release shall not constitute an offer to sell or the solicitation of an offer to buy securities in the United States, nor shall there be any sale of the securities in any jurisdiction in which such offer, solicitation or sale would be unlawful.
